functional_boundaries: This separate menu preview does not launch the chess game or campaign in ../web.
New creates one device-local demo save containing name, chapter label and timestamp; it replaces the previous slot.
Resume and Load display demo-save metadata; neither restores a chess position, moves or campaign progress.
Browse has an unavailable state only. There is no online match list, lobby, multiplayer, hosting or replay feature in this menu.
Particle quality and ambient motion affect menu presentation. Ambient volume persists a preference but is not connected to audio.
Home, Play and Settings are the only tabs. Placeholder EXAMPLE and community tabs and their notification badge are removed.
Back opens a Home confirmation. It does not close the browser or delete the save.
Gambit is the user-requested menu label; the preview does not expose or simulate the canonical campaign oath mechanic.
All four fixed 197 by 298 pixel cards remain visible at 1280 by 720, with four-pixel gaps and an 800-pixel row. This inventory does not change layout or artwork.

Home is a separate three-tile screen using the exact supplied titles and artwork. Tile activations display unavailable-state information only, without profile statistics, lore entries, news feeds or gameplay launches.
card_copy_intent: Player-facing destination intentions, as requested; activation dialogs disclose local demo saves, absent gameplay integration and unavailable online play. No unsupported launch action is offered.
